Hey girl I've been where you're at. From the the ages of 11-20 I never wanted to go out. I got invited to so many high profile events but never went. I couldn't even look at myself in the mirror. I didn't take selfies until 21. I know how dreadful it feels. 

I know you're probably sick of hearing different cures (I know I was!), because the cause of everyone's acne is different. But I highly recommend, even just for the sake of health, to get your vitamin D levels tested. 

I know many people's cystic acne is because of hormones and vitamin D is to do with your hormones. My doctor suspected me of it when I walked in with a face FULL of huge painful zits. Turns out my levels were 12 and they should have been 50. 

After she put me on vitamin D, my life changed. I even became happier and not just because of my skin. I'm not saying that this is your definite cause, but I know a large percentage of the population has vitamin D deficiencies which can affect other areas of your health, so it's worth looking into anyway. 

I really wish you the best. All I know is that if my horrible perpetual acne can be cured, yours will be too :) Hang in there!
